_comment: Replace the executives list with the people you track. Only 'name' is required. 'aliases' catches nicknames and spelling variants; 'company' disambiguates common names; 'company_aliases' catches other spellings of the company (tickers, former names); 'extra_terms' are extra keywords OR'd into the search.
_shorthand: An entry may also be one string carrying the company: "Jane Doe (Acme)", "Jane Doe (CEO, Acme)", "Jane Doe, Acme" or "Jane Doe - Acme".
_company_match: off = ignore the company | boost = reward a mention (default) | require = drop anything that never mentions it. Set 'company_match': 'require' on a person whose name is common. Can be set per person or here in settings for everyone.
